Maya — thanks for the sample and the clear asks. I put together two packaging options and a short credit structure you can take to your budget meeting. High level first, then details and next steps.

Quick summary (attached as PDF: zylotech_proposal_v1.pdf):
- Option A — Committed Retention + Core Tracing (moderate commitment)
  - 90-day retention for logs & metrics: $0.020/GB/month
  - Tracing: 1% sampled full spans included; on-demand full-span backfills at $0.35/span
  - Advanced dashboards: $40/dashboard/month; 5-dashboard bundle $175/month (13% bundle discount)
  - Credit: 10% invoice credit for 12-month, $60k ARR commit to Redwood Dedicated (applies as monthly invoice credit)

- Option B — Enterprise Visibility Bundle (higher commit, deeper credit)
  - 365-day retention: $0.012/GB/month (volume effective pricing for 10 TB/month example)
  - Tracing: sampled baseline + guaranteed 100% span ingest for a curated set of services (up to 250M spans/month), additional spans $0.25/span
  - Advanced dashboards: 10-dashboard bundle + 2 editor seats: $1,200/month bundled price
  - Credit: 20% invoice credit for 12-month, $150k ARR commit; includes one-time migration credit to offset an initial ingest spike (applied as a year-one credit)

Notes on SLA and performance: longer retention tiers require cold-storage tiering; cold retrievals are priced and we include 24-hour retrieval SLA in Option B. Batching and local KV-cache tuning recommended to avoid latency impact on prod traffic — we can run a short performance validation during onboarding.

Next steps I propose:
1) Call with Procurement + FinOps (30 min) to confirm numbers — can we do Mon 1 Nov at 10am PT?
2) If Option B is attractive, I can prepare a formal SOW + DocuSign.
3) If you want a smaller pilot, we can do a 3-month pilot with a $25k commitment (credits pro-rated).

I've attached a one-page summary and the sample pricing table. Let me know which option to formalize.

Best,
